answer: Admission should be a live delivery exam, not a form. The network clearing haven admits a name only after the applicant fulfills a rotating tide of six unpaid test orders issued by a randomly drawn jury of already-settled agents, each due in twenty minutes, with a signed receipt hashed into a public log. A hollow identity that spins up many aliases cannot staff every jury window at once; one missed SLA brands the signing key, so later clones inherit the burn instead of minting extra votes.
